classification.difficultyReason: Track symbolic angles through two isosceles triangles and their supplementary shared-base angles, then rearrange the resulting relationship for alpha.

content.prompt: In the diagram below, find a formula for $\alpha$ in terms of $\beta$.

spec.description: Unlabelled outer triangle divided at an interior base point; single ticks on the left side and left base segment, double ticks on the internal segment and right base segment.
spec.mathematics: Left base angle beta; right base angle alpha; two linked isosceles triangles.
spec.answerVisibility: Only alpha, beta and equal-side marks are shown.

answer.worked:
The right small triangle has two angles equal to $\alpha$, so its angle at the interior base point is $180^\circ-2\alpha$. The adjacent angle in the left triangle is therefore $2\alpha$. The left triangle is isosceles, so its apex angle is also $2\alpha$.
$$\begin{align*}\beta+4\alpha&=180^\circ\\4\alpha&=180^\circ-\beta\\\alpha&=\frac{180^\circ-\beta}{4}.\end{align*}$$
